concept: Who links to whom: dots on a quiet canvas joined by hairlines, the node in focus and its links lit, the rest faded, with a table view.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a network graph as a rainbow hairball of thick coloured edges
default_to_avoid.kind: network graph, force graph, node-link diagram
default_to_avoid.why_not: thick coloured edges hide the structure and colour every node for no reason; Pane keeps edges recessive and lights only the neighbourhood in focus

derivation.consequence: opaque pairs are computed, glass pairs are measured
derivation.form: edges are recessive hairlines in the grid tone

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: the arrow keys walk to the nearest node in that direction and a live line says its links

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: every link is also in the table view so nothing is read by colour alone

options: A hairlines with a lit neighbourhood
variants.picked: A hairlines with a lit neighbourhood
variants.reason: A shows structure on a quiet grid (dataviz). B is noise. C loses the shape of the network.

edge.why: a link is a hairline in the grid tone

on.why: a link of the node in focus turns to the primary tone

faded.why: everything outside the neighbourhood fades so the lit part reads

node.why: each node is a hit target bigger than its dot

dot.why: a dot carries its group colour from the content palette (D-031)

live.why: a hidden live line says the node in focus and its links

data-on.why: the node in focus gains a surface ring

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours links are grey and the lit ones take the highlight

stroke.why: a link lights at the hover duration so the neighbourhood appears without a flash

opacity.why: fading eases at the hover duration so the rest steps back without a flash
